data.one_liner: A Dart logging utility offering styled, tag‑filtered, in‑memory logs with JSON export and callbacks.
data.what_it_does: df_log replaces print() with colorful, emoji‑enhanced console output. It lets you assign tags, filter logs, store recent entries in memory, and export them as JSON lines. You can also attach callbacks for analytics or crash reporting.
use_when: You need readable, colored console logs during development
You want tag‑based filtering and in‑memory log history
You need to export logs for external analysis or crash reporting
avoid_when: You need a full‑featured logging framework with log levels and sinks
strengths: Export to JSONL and custom callbacks
weaknesses: Limited to console styling; may not work on all terminals
No advanced log routing or multiple sinks

alternatives.name: stack_trace
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides detailed stack traces and can be combined with other logging solutions for richer error info
